dialogues.jp:
日曜日ということで、公園は結構な人出で｛にぎ／賑｝わっ
ていた。
dialogues.en: The park was crowded with people because it was Sunday.
dialogues.text: The park was crowded with people because it was Sunday.

dialogues.jp:
これだけ天気もよく、暖かければ、なんとなく
でも散歩なんかしてみたいと思うのだろう。
dialogues.en:
I guess everybody wants to go for a walk since the weather's
nice and warm.
dialogues.text:
I guess everybody wants to go for a walk since the weather's
nice and warm.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、お兄ちゃん見て見て、たこ焼きの屋台が
　出てる」
dialogues.en: "Hey, look, oniichan! There's an octopus ball stand!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, look, oniichan! There's an octopus ball stand!"

dialogues.jp: ぐいっ、と音夢が俺の袖をひっぱる。
dialogues.en: Nemu pulled my sleeve.
dialogues.text: Nemu pulled my sleeve.

dialogues.jp: その手を握り返してはいけない。
dialogues.en: I can't take that hand and hold it.
dialogues.text: I can't take that hand and hold it.

dialogues.jp: 音夢は──。
dialogues.en:
She isn't doing it as a girlfriend, but she's doing it as a
sister.
dialogues.text:
She isn't doing it as a girlfriend, but she's doing it as a
sister.

dialogues.jp:
恋人ではなく、あくまで兄妹として接している
のだから。
dialogues.en: I took a deep breath and exhaled slowly.
dialogues.text: I took a deep breath and exhaled slowly.

dialogues.jp: そして俺も、そうしなければいけない。
dialogues.en: "Cough."
dialogues.text: "Cough."

dialogues.jp: 大きく息を吸って、長く吐き出す。
dialogues.en:
I coughed because of the pain in my chest and something got
stuck in my throat.
dialogues.text:
I coughed because of the pain in my chest and something got
stuck in my throat.

dialogues.en: "Mm...... yeah. I got something stuck."
dialogues.text: "Mm...... yeah. I got something stuck."

dialogues.jp:
胸が痛んだのと、器官になにかつまったのか咳
き込んでしまう。
dialogues.en:
I twisted my lips as I let go of my hand I was putting on my
chest.
dialogues.text:
I twisted my lips as I let go of my hand I was putting on my
chest.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫？」
dialogues.en:
"You have to take it easy. You aren't completely recovered
yet."
dialogues.text:
"You have to take it easy. You aren't completely recovered
yet."

dialogues.jp:
思わず胸に当ててしまっていた手を離して、唇
をまげる。
dialogues.en: "I've fallen dreadfully low to have you worry about me."
dialogues.text: "I've fallen dreadfully low to have you worry about me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「無理しちゃ駄目だよ……お兄ちゃんだってま
　だ病み上がりなんだから」
dialogues.en: "Hey! That's not...... Cough!"
dialogues.text: "Hey! That's not...... Cough!"

dialogues.jp: とんとん、と音夢の背中を叩く。
dialogues.en: "See? Don't waste your energy."
dialogues.text: "See? Don't waste your energy."

dialogues.jp: 抱きしめたことのある背中を──。
dialogues.en: I patted on her back.
dialogues.text: I patted on her back.

dialogues.en: "Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……もぅ、そういうときだけ真剣にやさしい
　んだから」
dialogues.en: "This is the only time you're actually nice."
dialogues.text: "This is the only time you're actually nice."

dialogues.jp: 口元に指をあてて音夢がすねた声をだす。
dialogues.en: Nemu put her fingers on her mouth and pouted.
dialogues.text: Nemu put her fingers on her mouth and pouted.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「私は無理そうでも、お兄ちゃんには明日から
　ちゃ〜んと学園に行ってもらいますから」
dialogues.en:
"I won't be able to, but I'll make you go to school
tomorrow."
dialogues.text:
"I won't be able to, but I'll make you go to school
tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「分かったよ」
dialogues.en: "Fine."
dialogues.text: "Fine."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄妹そろって春休みからずっと家にこもりっ
　きりなんて、なにを言われるか分かりません
　から」
dialogues.en:
"I wonder what people say if we stayed home together since
spring break."
dialogues.text:
"I wonder what people say if we stayed home together since
spring break."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……分かってるよ」
苦笑する。
dialogues.en: I smiled wryly.
dialogues.text: I smiled wryly.

dialogues.jp: 多分、そう噂されるのが真実だったのだ。
dialogues.en: Perhaps what people gossiped about was the truth.
dialogues.text: Perhaps what people gossiped about was the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「分かってるんだったら、ちゃぁんとご飯を食
　べて風邪を治しましょ」
dialogues.en: "Then, you should eat well and get rid of the cold."
dialogues.text: "Then, you should eat well and get rid of the cold."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……そんなにたこ焼きが食べたいのか？」
dialogues.en: "You want to eat octopus balls that bad?"
dialogues.text: "You want to eat octopus balls that bad?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうせ外で食事をしようって言ったんだから、
　いいでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "Well, you said you wanted to eat out, so do you mind?"
dialogues.text: "Well, you said you wanted to eat out, so do you mind?"

dialogues.jp: てへへ、と笑う。
dialogues.en: She smiled embarrassedly.
dialogues.text: She smiled embarrassedly.

dialogues.jp: 「かったりいなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "What a pain......"
dialogues.text: "What a pain......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うわっ、ご飯食べるのにまでかったるい、っ
　て言い出しちゃったの？」
dialogues.en: "You start saying that even when you eat?"
dialogues.text: "You start saying that even when you eat?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうじゃないけどな〜」
dialogues.en: "Well, not quite..."
dialogues.text: "Well, not quite..."

dialogues.jp: 言い訳を考えようと空を見上げた。
dialogues.en: I looked up the sky trying to think of an excuse.
dialogues.text: I looked up the sky trying to think of an excuse.

dialogues.jp:
「俺もお前も一応は病人なんだから、もう少し
　テンションを下げようや」
dialogues.en:
"You're still sick too, so maybe you should tone it down a
little."
dialogues.text:
"You're still sick too, so maybe you should tone it down a
little."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それは分かってますけど、別に暗くしてたか
　らって治るものでもないでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "I know that, but it won't help me heal."
dialogues.text: "I know that, but it won't help me heal."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はいはい」
dialogues.en: "Fine."
dialogues.text: "Fine."

dialogues.jp: 音夢に手をひかれるまま足が進む。
dialogues.en: I walked as Nemu dragged me.
dialogues.text: I walked as Nemu dragged me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「デートみたいなものだよ」
dialogues.en: "It's like a date."
dialogues.text: "It's like a date."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうしたのお兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "What? What's up, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "What? What's up, oniichan?"

dialogues.jp: 純真な瞳が俺を見上げる。
dialogues.en: The innocent eyes looked at me.
dialogues.text: The innocent eyes looked at me.

dialogues.jp: 俺の知っている、俺の知らない瞳がある。
dialogues.en: These are the eyes I know, but I don't know.
dialogues.text: These are the eyes I know, but I don't know.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "No, nothing."
dialogues.text: "No, nothing."

dialogues.jp: 勘違いだ。
dialogues.en: I misunderstood it.
dialogues.text: I misunderstood it.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の一言一言に、兄妹への愛情を隠すような
裏があると思うのは妄想だろう。
dialogues.en:
I must be paranoid to think she's hiding her feelings behind
every word she says.
dialogues.text:
I must be paranoid to think she's hiding her feelings behind
every word she says.

dialogues.jp: だけどなんとなく……。
dialogues.en:
"Have you ever thought about what we look like to other
people?"
dialogues.text:
"Have you ever thought about what we look like to other
people?"

dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、俺達どういう関係に見えるかな？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 聞いてしまった。
dialogues.en: She stopped.
dialogues.text: She stopped.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "You and me?"
dialogues.text: "You and me?"

dialogues.jp: 足が止まった。
dialogues.en: She looked around and tilted her head.
dialogues.text: She looked around and tilted her head.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私とお兄ちゃんが？」
dialogues.en: "Brother and sister?"
dialogues.text: "Brother and sister?"

dialogues.jp: 周囲を見渡して音夢が首をかしげる。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄妹でしょ？」
dialogues.en: "As is..."
dialogues.text: "As is..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Naturally."
dialogues.text: "Naturally."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まんまだな」
dialogues.en: Nemu spin around as she smiled.
dialogues.text: Nemu spin around as she smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「当たり前です」
dialogues.en:
"You can sit down and wait for me, if it's too much trouble
for you."
dialogues.text:
"You can sit down and wait for me, if it's too much trouble
for you."

dialogues.jp: 微笑んで、くるり、とその場で音夢が回る。
dialogues.en: "I'll do that."
dialogues.text: "I'll do that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「面倒でしたら、お兄ちゃんは椅子に座って待っ
　ててください」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
声に合わせて元気に走ったりはしないが、テン
ポのよい歩調で音夢が歩きさる。
dialogues.en: Nemu walked away happily as she answered.
dialogues.text: Nemu walked away happily as she answered.

dialogues.jp:
桜の風の中で、俺はしばらくその背中を見送っ
てから椅子に腰を落とした。
dialogues.en:
I looked at her back for a while, feeling the wind, and I
sat down on a bench.
dialogues.text:
I looked at her back for a while, feeling the wind, and I
sat down on a bench.

dialogues.jp: 「あいつも、そろそろ復学できるかな……」
dialogues.en: "Maybe she can go back to school soon......"
dialogues.text: "Maybe she can go back to school soon......"

dialogues.jp: そうなってしまえば、いつもの日常に戻れる。
dialogues.en:
We can go back to the usual routine once she goes back to
school.
dialogues.text:
We can go back to the usual routine once she goes back to
school.

dialogues.jp: 楽しかったあの頃に。
dialogues.en: The time we had so much fun.
dialogues.text: The time we had so much fun.

dialogues.jp: 新しいスタートを。
dialogues.en: We can have a new start.
dialogues.text: We can have a new start.

dialogues.jp: ただ――ただ――。
そうなってしまったら、もう届かない気がした。
dialogues.en: We can never go back when it happens.
dialogues.text: We can never go back when it happens.

dialogues.jp:
このまま日常に帰ってしまったら、もう音夢と
は一生結ばれることはないのではと。
dialogues.en:
Nemu and I can never be together again for the rest of our
lives once we go back to that old routine.
dialogues.text:
Nemu and I can never be together again for the rest of our
lives once we go back to that old routine.

dialogues.jp: 「……怖いのか、俺？」
dialogues.en: "Am I afraid?"
dialogues.text: "Am I afraid?"

dialogues.jp: 分からない。
dialogues.en: I don't know.
dialogues.text: I don't know.

dialogues.jp: チャンスがないわけではないのだろう。
dialogues.en: I'm sure there's a chance.
dialogues.text: I'm sure there's a chance.

dialogues.jp: もう一度繰り返せばいいのだ。
dialogues.en: We can repeat the process.
dialogues.text: We can repeat the process.

dialogues.jp: 想い出も愛情も、もう一度。
dialogues.en: The memories and the love, once again.
dialogues.text: The memories and the love, once again.

dialogues.jp:
だが、このまま手放してしまえば、俺は音夢に
触れることにも｛ためら／躊躇｝うだろう。
dialogues.en: But if I let go of her now, she'll be gone forever.
dialogues.text: But if I let go of her now, she'll be gone forever.

dialogues.jp: それならば、これが最後のチャンスだ。
dialogues.en: If that's the case, then this is the last chance I have.
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then this is the last chance I have.

dialogues.jp: 俺は――
◆リハビリの散歩◆
dialogues.en: ◆Taking a walk as rehab◆
dialogues.text: ◆Taking a walk as rehab◆

dialogues.jp:
ある程度まで元気にはなったが、代わりに俺と
恋人であることを忘れてしまった音夢と、昼下
がりの公園を散歩する。
dialogues.en:
Nemu and I walked around the park one afternoon. She seems
to be feeling much better, but doesn't remember we were a
couple.
dialogues.text:
Nemu and I walked around the park one afternoon. She seems
to be feeling much better, but doesn't remember we were a
couple.

dialogues.jp:
たこ焼きが食べたいと笑う音夢に、俺は複雑な
心境にならざるを得なかった。
dialogues.en:
I felt complicated as she smiled at me saying she wants an
octopus ball.
dialogues.text:
I felt complicated as she smiled at me saying she wants an
octopus ball.

dialogues.jp:
このまま音夢が元気でいてくれるか、俺との関
係を取り戻すことが本当の幸せなのか――。
dialogues.en:
What would be the real happiness? Is it for her to be
healthy like this? Or is it for us to rekindle our
relationship?
dialogues.text:
What would be the real happiness? Is it for her to be
healthy like this? Or is it for us to rekindle our
relationship?
